clean_interface_scope: Hadamard-Rybczynski limiting comparison, not current shelled bubble
tool_decision: No installation: DOLFINx Stokes solver is available as mature option but physical first-order field, wall motion/slip, attenuation and validation benchmark are not yet specified.
next_benchmarks: Measure phase/amplitude and cavity pressure first
Independent second-order Stokes with verified wall slip or resolved boundary layer; benchmark Bach-Bruus cavity before particle coupling
Measure rotation with tracer PIV and compare frequency/power scaling
Separate acoustic-OFF buoyancy and near-wall mobility benchmark
Build APECSS tables per radius/shell/frequency, never reuse 1.78 um response for new radii

references.title: Bach & Bruus (2018), pressure acoustics with boundary layers and streaming
references.relevance: Validated wall-slip formulation; cavity geometry and wall motion matter.

references.title: Bach & Bruus (2019), bulk-driven streaming at resonance
references.relevance: Overlapping cavity modes can support rotating energy flux and streaming; not evidence that this uncalibrated device does.

references.title: Ahmed et al. (2016), rotational manipulation using acoustic waves
references.relevance: Experiment reports microbubble-driven microstreaming and rotation at kHz; scale/frequency differ from current 2.5 MHz.

references.title: DOLFINx official Taylor-Hood Stokes demo
references.relevance: Mature incompressible solver; no device-specific acoustic forcing or boundary calibration supplied.

references.title: APECSS upstream software
references.relevance: Supports response generation; any new bubble class requires matching validated inputs.

buoyancy_to_restoring_Fz_diagnostic.scope: Force-scale comparison only. Gravity orientation, shell mass and actual field remain uncalibrated; no equilibrium/trajectory predicted.
